O seletor de ano estabelece o recorte te: The year selector defines the time window available for exploring the network and comparing connections. It makes clear which literature is being considered, rather than presenting every result as current knowledge. Open the selector, choose a cutoff and check the displayed year before continuing. Comparing cutoffs can reveal changes in associations, although data coverage also affects the interpretation.
Rede facilita a observação de grupos e p: Network helps reveal groups and bibliographic bridges. Hierarchy organizes concepts by subject. 3D provides an alternative spatial view. Articles, in the top navigation, provides publication records and the subject tree. No single representation answers every question: choose Network to explore relationships, Hierarchy to navigate topics and Articles to examine the sources.
Digite um assunto, parte do nome de um d: Enter a topic, part of a descriptor name or its MeSH identifier. Search helps locate concepts without browsing the entire map and lets you check whether a term matches the intended concept. Review the result names before selecting them. If a topic is not found, try another name or its identifier; absence from search does not establish absence of studies.
Os filtros delimitam a pergunta que você: Filters define the question you are investigating. OR broadens the selection to alternative criteria; AND requires the applicable criteria together. Clear filters removes restrictions to restore a broad view. Use OR to explore the neighborhoods of different areas and AND to focus on their intersection. An empty set may result from overly restrictive criteria, so review the filters before interpreting the absence.
Os botões de categoria na base do mapa p: Category buttons at the bottom of the map add or remove MeSH branches from the subset. Colors connect each area visually to its concepts, while counts indicate its size. This helps reduce noise in dense networks or compare topics across areas. Combine categories with search, remembering that thematic classification does not establish causality.
Mostrar nós não selecionados mantém visí: When enabled, Show unselected nodes keeps the context outside the filter visible. Center results moves the view to the selected set, helping you find it again after navigating. These controls switch between focus and context without confusing the research subset with the camera position. If Center results is disabled, check whether any results are selected.
Arestas exibe ou oculta as linhas de con: Edges shows or hides connection lines to make dense regions easier to read. Color by degree highlights the number of connections of a node; Color by growth shows the growth measure when available. Category colors distinguish areas. Use these options to compare different aspects of the same set; high connectivity and growth do not by themselves establish clinical relevance or methodological quality.
Selecione 3D para examinar a rede em out: Select 3D to examine the network from another perspective. Rotate, available in this mode, controls automatic rotation and helps reveal structures that overlap in a projection. Pause rotation to inspect a concept. The space is a visual organization of the graph, not physical coordinates or a direct measure of experimental similarity.

AI Connection Discovery é um ambiente de: AI Connection Discovery is an environment for exploring biomedical literature that combines a concept map, article retrieval, subject hierarchies and assisted hypothesis generation. It helps identify relationships that can be missed when reading within one specialty or using isolated searches. Its starting point is the literature included in the platform: the map represents that bibliographic subset, not all scientific knowledge.
A plataforma serve como instrumento de i: The platform supports investigation and question formulation. Students can explore the neighborhood of a topic, researchers can examine bridges across areas, and teams can select connections for literature review. Every path must be interpreted in light of its articles and experimental context.
A lógica central é a descoberta baseada: The core approach is literature-based discovery, often represented as A–B–C. If one body of work relates A to B and another relates B to C, B can bridge an investigation of A and C. The conceptual inspiration is to connect knowledge fragments across separate communities or publication sets. Not every bridge leads to discovery: a connection may be trivial, indirect, incompatible or already known outside the corpus.
A motivação é tornar a exploração interd: The aim is to make interdisciplinary exploration explicit and verifiable. Instead of merely presenting generated text, the interface starts with concepts, connections and articles before an explanation is formulated. This describes the project's principle; it does not attribute a personal history or an experimental discovery to its authors.
Os dados bibliográficos têm origem no Pu: Bibliographic data originate from PubMed, with concepts organized using MeSH descriptors. Article counts, years and available cutoffs should be read from the interface indicators. They define the scope of exploration. An absent or weakly connected topic may be underrepresented in the imported set without being scientifically unimportant.
Os arquivos e serviços utilizados pela v: Files and services used by the published version determine which queries are available. Do not assume that the map reproduces all of PubMed in real time or includes every MeSH update. Check the original PubMed record for title, date and bibliographic details before using a result in your work.
MeSH organiza assuntos biomédicos por de: MeSH organizes biomedical subjects using standardized descriptors, identifiers and hierarchical positions. Identifiers distinguish similarly named concepts, while the hierarchy moves from broad areas to specific topics. A descriptor may appear along several tree paths; this reflects relationships to different branches and does not necessarily indicate an error or duplicate articles.
A árvore existe para orientar a navegaçã: The tree guides subject navigation; the network shows bibliographic relationships between concepts. These views complement each other: classification proximity and publication co-occurrence answer different questions. Check descriptor names and identifiers to avoid treating a broad category as a specific concept.
Na visualização do mapa, um nó correspon: In the map, a node corresponds to a concept and an edge represents an observed co-occurrence relationship in the data. Descriptors associated with the same article provide a signal of bibliographic proximity. Counts and network structure help explore shared literature and potential bridging concepts.
O desenho é uma representação para explo: The layout supports exploration. A point's position, color or links do not demonstrate causality, treatment efficacy or equivalence between concepts. Rendering limits and filters may reduce what appears, so distinguish corpus totals from displayed elements.
O seletor de ano permite explorar a conf: The year selector explores literature associated with an available cutoff. It separates knowledge used to propose a connection from later literature used to examine it. Check the active cutoff before interpreting results: changing the year changes the bibliographic context and may change pairs and evidence.
Uma relação encontrada depois do corte p: A relationship observed after the cutoff may provide an interesting subsequent signal, but publication does not prove that the platform discovered a mechanism. Check whether the relationship was already described in publications absent from the data, whether terms have the same meaning and whether the later study actually supports the hypothesis.
Rede, Hierarquia e 3D oferecem entradas: Network, Hierarchy and 3D provide different entry points to topics in the Map. Articles has a separate top-level tab. Text search locates names and identifiers; categories restrict the subject subset; AND and OR change how criteria combine. Center results returns to the selected set after navigation. Show unselected nodes preserves surrounding context when enabled.
Edges controls connection lines. Color by degree highlights connectivity; Color by growth provides another view when available. Turning these off restores category colors. None of these colors certify scientific quality. Use them to ask questions and check interpretations against counts, descriptors and articles.

Artigos permite percorrer a organização: Articles explores MeSH organization and publications related to a selected subset. Expand branches to reach specific topics, select descriptors and observe changing results. Use title or PMID search when available. Descriptor chips help move from an article to related subjects.
A combinação OU amplia a consulta para r: OR broadens queries to records matching any selected descriptor; AND requires the applicable criteria together. If results are empty, review the combination and cutoff before concluding that no literature exists. PubMed links open the bibliographic source, where details and full text may be available.
Busca global explora conexões no conjunt: Global search explores connections in the set considered by the inference engine. Keywords focuses search on user-selected concepts. Infer connections runs with current settings and updates the ranking when results are available. This separates question definition from calculation and avoids treating every visual change as a new analysis.
A ordem do ranking é uma prioridade calc: Ranking order is a priority calculated by the implemented method, not a universal probability of truth. Bridges, counts and scores are screening signals. Compare concepts and intermediaries, and discard interpretations based on superficial word associations. Even highly ranked results require expert review.

Avoid personal or confidential information. Never put the key into search, guide questions or public text.
Após a geração, Verificar no PubMed pós-: After generation, Check PubMed after the cutoff searches later literature associated with the proposal. It gathers material to assess whether the connection received bibliographic support and under which conditions. Read returned studies, dates and actual subjects: mentioning both concepts does not mean their proposed relationship was tested.
A hipótese, o mecanismo e o impacto pote: The hypothesis, mechanism and potential impact are interpretations that may contain errors. Use limitations to identify gaps and falsification criteria to turn a plausible narrative into a testable question. Absent results do not automatically refute a hypothesis, and present results do not automatically confirm it. Conclusions require evidence assessment and, when appropriate, experimental investigation.
Comece definindo um tema e o corte. Loca: Start with a topic and cutoff. Locate descriptors, compare network and tree views, and open articles to understand the vocabulary. Adjust filters, choose global search or keywords and request inference. Select a relevant connection, formulate a hypothesis in Agents and examine later literature. Record the cutoff, concepts and sources so others can follow the reasoning.
A plataforma apoia exploração científica: The platform supports scientific exploration and learning; results are not clinical recommendations and do not replace systematic review or methodological analysis. The Guide provides local instructions on controls; Gemini contributes to scientific generation when requested.
